g.text: Quantimation line rules: widths are screen px at 1920x1080 (stage units = px / 1.5)
All samples below are drawn by src/line-engine.mjs at 1:1, so measure them directly.
background contour (colour: local fill darkened, never ink)
background interior (colour: local fill darkened, never ink)
far parallax layer (colour: local fill darkened, never ink)
Taper profile for open strokes (width fraction along the stroke)
Curve: smoothstep. Closed contours do not taper. Their width varies by ±15%
instead, heavier on the side away from the light.
A stroke ending in a T-junction keeps 100% width.
Wobble: fixed per drawing (seeded), measured in px along the normal, with corners kept sharp
corners above 35° keep 0 wobble within 6 px
The same drawing gives the same wobble on every frame.
Noise octaves: 90 px wavelength at 0.7 weight
Resample the path every 3 px before displacing.
Boil is off unless a layer opts in (see BIBLE.md).
